_note: MEarth South at CTIO: eight telescopes (tel11-tel18) under one roll-off roof.
Adapted from the MEarth observing system (J. Irwin, used with permission); see docs/mearth_roof.md.
One file for the enclosure, read by both services (robofast_core/config.py):
dome: the MEarth roof Alpaca server (roof.json listens on 11150; hardware not allowed there until confirmed on site).

safetymonitor, observingconditions: the weather bridge (weather.yaml listens on 11111). Its station source is a placeholder: no reader for the site's weather station and cloud sensor exists yet, so the bridge reports unsafe and nothing opens.

tel11-tel18: placeholders for each telescope PC's Alpaca (ASCOM Remote) mount and camera. The legacy mounts and cameras were driven through Windows software; which Alpaca drivers serve them is to be decided.

No hardware heartbeat: the roof interface box holds its last command and has no watchdog, so nothing closes the roof if the supervisor dies. attended_only (also the default without a heartbeat): no lease, and the roof never opens, unless an operator is on duty.
park_before_close: a roll-off roof closes over the telescopes; legacy parked at alt 10, az 190 (telescope.cfg). Clearance with other park positions is unconfirmed.

fault_action Faults: a roof that timed out, never left its limit, shows both limits or neither, alarms and blocks opening (docs/mearth_roof.md). No automatic clearing (legacy never cleared its STUCK flag by itself).
reopen_hold 1200 s: legacy latched each weather alert for 20 minutes (alert_timeout).
site: legacy MEarth::Config for CTIO (-30 10 20.9, -70 48 00.5, 2124 m).
